headline: Industry enters new stage: many Chinese regions end low-altitude economy support policies
summary: Several Chinese regions, including Hangzhou, have issued documents repealing low-altitude economy policies. The reasons cited mostly point to fair-competition review requirements for administrative documents.
why: The low-altitude economy covers drones and electric aircraft, and local government subsidies have been a key driver of its growth in China.
